data.gender_notes: Ramparvesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram meaning God and Parvesh meaning messenger or emissary, so Ramparvesh can be interpreted as God's messenger. The name Ramparvesh carries the meaning “God's messenger” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramparvesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
